notes: N and D are in billions; marginal benefits are Loss reduction per additional billion units.
Grid support is a marginal B1 bounding box, not verified joint support.

Lambda values are assumptions, not estimates or confidence limits.
Scale-fold parameter spread is development sensitivity, not a confidence interval.
